item.title: Open the hives: Why France is turning tank gunners into FPV pilots
item.dc:creator: Amarjeet Singh
item.description:
From AMX-10 RC gunners to FPV strike pilots: Inside the French Army's radical transformation of its light cavalry into dedicated hunter-drone squadrons.
[SPLIT] ⚡ During Exercise Hedgehog in Estonia, French FPV pilots accounted for 20% of total attrition inflicted on opposing U.S. forces with M2A4 Bradleys. [SPLIT] ⚡ The French Army plans to scale up to approximately 15 drone-combat units by summer 2027 to modernize tactical deterrence. item.title: Google's Orbiting TPU Test Marks a New Era for Edge Defense AI
item.dc:creator: Amarjeet Singh
item.description:
Google just successfully booted an AI chip-equipped satellite into orbit, running the Gemma 4 model in space. Project Suncatcher is paving the way for resilient space-based data centers by 2027.
[SPLIT] ⚡ Project Suncatcher aims to test thermal stress and radiation resilience ahead of a twin-satellite interconnection milestone in 2027. [SPLIT] ⚡ Orbital AI processing fundamentally reduces latency and dependency on vulnerable terrestrial ground stations during conflicts.
